children.blockName: Invento was founded in 2008 with a bold goal: to boost wood flooring consumable performance while lowering costs.
What is the lacquer coating thickness

there is a reason why manufacturers state an amount of lacquer to be applied per coat. If you find that you ‘cant put any more on’ or ‘I cant put it on any thinner’ then you are using the wrong tools or technique to apply the product! If you do not apply the right amount you will not get the spec that the manufacturer states on the can and the data sheet. Too little and you will have less wear resistance, an uneven finish and possibly even adhesion issues. Too much and you will slow down the drying and curing time. It isn’t just to sell more lacquer or whatever conspiracy theory you think, it is a carefully and scientifically arrived at specification to give the specified properties that were presumably why you bought the product in the first place.
